The '''Mandalorian attack land vehicle''' was a ground vehicle used by the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] during the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. The vehicle centered around a giant wheel, with a cockpit section in front, and cannons attached to smaller structures on each side of the central wheel.<ref name="DWLJ" /> Armored vehicles of this kind participated in the [[Taris Siege]] in [[3963 BBY]].<ref name="KOTOR22" />
